name: AO Vertical Wind Tunnel Demo
author: billcrowther
description:
Drop rag doll skydivers and random shaped objects into a vertical wind tunnel. Change the wind speed and see what happens.  Wind tunnel is built using a custom Fluid Zone that produces a local vertical wind that drops off with height. Objects are randomised in terms of shape and centre of mass location.                                                                
www.aerodynamicobjects.com                                               
Skydivers are built using a mannequin asset purchased from Bevans Media https://assetstore.unity.com/publishers/3631
